comments.author: B!
comments.body: To be honest this seems like a very good job for a sailing trader. It has frugality and storage which will allow you to get less equipment degradation as well as less suplies consumption. It has soc and accounts so you can invest and haggle better. And to top it off it has cooking and luxuries trading. The only downside really here would be that it doesnt have fishing. If it did it would be an amazing job

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Now available as of the Extreme North Sea patch, this job is a 5-star quest from Amsterdam's Business Mediator called "The tavern's new product". It lists R5 Luxuries Trading, Indian and Chinese languages as required, but a friend pulled it with just r5 Luxuries Trading, and none of the languages. Steps:

1. Talk to Amsterdam's Barkeep x1
2. Talk to Calicut's Marketkeeper x1
3. Talk to Hangzhou's Nanban Trade Merchant x1

You don't need either of the listed languages to pull the quest, or to complete it; Body Language works fine. And while R5 Luxuries Trading is essential to pulling this quest, you don't need it for any of the NPC talking points.
